canonical.sourceFilePath: 16. Strings (Hard)/Hard/01. Minimum number of insertions to make parenthesis valid.cpp

narrative.title: The Signal Bracket Balancer
narrative.scenario: A telemetry parser rejects any packet whose bracket pattern is unbalanced — every opener needs a later closer, and no closer may arrive unpaired. Patching firmware per packet is expensive, so the gateway instead counts the fewest single brackets to splice in anywhere to legitimize the stream.
narrative.inputFormat: A string s containing only '(' and ')'.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum number of bracket insertions needed to make s valid.

testCases.explanation: One insertion fixes the trailing closer: "(())" or "()()".
Each unmatched opener needs its own closing bracket.

hintLevels: Level 1: Track unmatched openers and orphan closers separately — both must be patched.
Level 2: A ')' consumes a pending '(' if one exists; otherwise it adds to the orphan count.
Level 3: The answer is just pending + orphans after one scan; no stack needed.
